description: Implementation of a network helper class for QUIC client, managing UDP socket creation, packet reading, and event loop handling.

classes.name: QuicClientMessageLooplNetworkHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing QUIC client network operations, including socket creation, packet reading, and event loop control.

methods.name: CreateUDPSocketAndBind
methods.description: Creates and binds a UDP socket to the specified server address and port, setting buffer sizes and local address.

methods.name: CleanUpAllUDPSockets
methods.description: Resets the client writer, packet reader, and related state.

methods.name: StartPacketReaderIfNotStarted
methods.description: Starts the packet reader if it has not already been started.

methods.name: RunEventLoop
methods.description: Runs the event loop until idle.

methods.name: CreateQuicPacketWriter
methods.description: Creates a new QUIC packet writer for sending packets.

methods.name: OnReadError
methods.description: Handles read errors from the socket, disconnecting the client.

methods.name: GetLatestClientAddress
methods.description: Returns the latest client address used.

methods.name: OnPacket
methods.description: Processes an incoming UDP packet and forwards it to the client's session connection.
